name: Seamless.AI Contact Structure
description: Structural inventory of the Seamless.AI Contact record as returned by the Public API.
provenance: Derived from the provider-published OpenAPI at https://docs.seamless.ai/openapi.json (harvested 2026-08-14); field names, descriptions and examples are carried verbatim from that spec.

contactId.description: Unique identifier for this contact record.

username.description: Email address of the Seamless.AI user who researched this contact.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this contact record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this contact record was last updated.

fullName.description: Contact's full display name (first + middle + last).

nameOriginal.description: Contact's name as originally sourced, before any normalization.

email.description: Primary email address selected for this contact.

contactPhone1.description: Primary direct phone number for the contact.

contactPhone1TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the primary contact phone number.

contactPhone1DataType.description: Type classification of the primary contact phone (e.g., mobile, main).

contactPhone2.description: Secondary direct phone number for the contact.

contactPhone2DataType.description: Type classification of the secondary contact phone.

companyPhone1.description: Primary phone number for the contact's company.

companyPhone1TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the primary company phone number.

companyPhone1DataType.description: Type classification of the primary company phone.

companyPhone2.description: Secondary phone number for the contact's company.

companyPhone2TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the secondary company phone number.

companyPhone2DataType.description: Type classification of the secondary company phone.

companyPhone3.description: Tertiary phone number for the contact's company.

companyPhone3TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the tertiary company phone number.

companyPhone3DataType.description: Type classification of the tertiary company phone.

company.description: Current company name of the contact.

companyOriginal.description: Company name as originally sourced, before any normalization.

companyDescription.description: Description or summary of the contact's company.
companyDescription.example: Acme Corp is a leading provider of innovative business solutions.

companyIndustry.description: Industry classification of the contact's company.

companyStaffCount.description: Approximate total number of employees at the company.

companyAnnualRevenue.description: Estimated annual revenue in USD (numeric string).

companyDomain.description: Primary website domain of the company.

companyLinkedInId.description: LinkedIn numeric identifier for the company.

seniority.description: Seniority level of the contact's role (e.g., C-Level, VP, Director, Manager, Senior, Entry Level).

lISalesNavUrl.description: Contact's LinkedIn Sales Navigator profile URL.

companyLocation.description: Headquarters or primary office address of the contact's company.

emailDomain.description: Domain portion of the contact's email address, if available.

image.description: URL to the contact's profile photo, if available.

email1.description: First email address found for the contact (typically the primary/selected email).

email1Selected.description: Whether this email was selected as the primary email for the contact.

email1TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the first email address.

email1EmailAI.description: Email validation status for the first email address (e.g., valid, invalid, risky).

email2.description: Second email address found for the contact.

email2TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the second email address.

email2EmailAI.description: Email validation status for the second email address.

email3.description: Third email address found for the contact.

email3TotalAI.description: Confidence score (percentage) for the third email address.

email3EmailAI.description: Email validation status for the third email address.

advertisingIntelligence.description: URL to advertising intelligence data for the contact's company.

alexaScore.description: URL to Alexa site information for the company domain.

companyNews.description: URL to Google News search results for the company.

employeeReviews.description: URL to Glassdoor employee reviews for the company.

googleFinance.description: URL to Google Finance page for the company.

googleResearch.description: URL to a Google search for the contact at their company.

jobPostings.description: URL to Glassdoor job postings for the company.

localSportsTeams.description: URL to a Google search for local sports teams near the company HQ.

localWeather.description: URL to a Google search for weather near the company HQ.

paidSearchIntelligence.description: URL to SEMrush paid search data for the company domain.

paidSearchKeywordsIntelligence.description: URL to KeywordSpy keyword research for the company domain.

searchMarketingIntelligence.description: URL to iSpionage search marketing data for the company domain.

secFilings.description: URL to SEC EDGAR filings for the company.

seoResearch.description: URL to Ahrefs SEO data for the company domain.

similarWebsites.description: URL to find websites similar to the company domain.

socialMediaMentions.description: URL to social media mention tracking for the company domain.

socialMediaPosts.description: URL to social media post search for the company domain.

socialPosts.description: URL to blog/social post search for the contact.

websiteAudit.description: URL to SimilarWeb traffic analysis for the company domain.

websiteAudit2.description: URL to WooRank website audit for the company domain.

websiteGrader.description: URL to HubSpot Website Grader analysis for the company domain.

webTechnologies.description: URL to BuiltWith technology lookup for the company domain.

whois.description: URL to WHOIS domain registration lookup for the company domain.

wikipedia.description: URL to the Wikipedia page for the company, if available.

yahooFinance.description: URL to Yahoo Finance page for the company.

formerCompany.description: Name of the contact's most recent previous employer.

formerTitle.description: Job title at the contact's most recent previous employer.

formerStartedAt.description: Date the contact started at their former company (YYYY-MM-DD).

formerEndedAt.description: Date the contact left their former company (YYYY-MM-DD).

titleStartedAt.description: Date the contact started their current title (YYYY-MM-DD).

startedAtCurrentCompany.description: Date the contact started at their current company (YYYY-MM-DD).

timeAtRole.description: Human-readable tenure in the contact's current role, derived from `titleStartedAt` (e.g. "1 Yr 2 Mo", "3 Mo").

timeAtCompany.description: Human-readable tenure at the contact's current company, derived from `startedAtCurrentCompany` (e.g. "1 Yr 2 Mo", "3 Mo").

jobChangeAlert.description: Type of job change detected given provided or default job change date range. When detected; 'New Hire' = joined a new company, 'New Promotion' = new role at the same company.

stockTicker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company, if publicly traded.

apiResearchId.description: The request ID returned from the /contacts/research endpoint. Use this to correlate research requests with results.

newsAndEvents.description: Recent news articles related to the company.

companyFundingTotal.description: The latest total funding amount for the company.

companyLatestFundingDate.description: The date of the latest funding round for the company (formatted as "YYYY-MM-DD").

companyLatestFundingClassifications.description: The classifications of the latest funding round for the company (e.g., "Series A", "Pre-Seed", etc.).
